one_liner_zh: 超微EPS大幅超預期近16%，資料中心成長動能延續。
one_liner_en: AMD beats EPS by nearly 16% as data-center momentum continues.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS驚喜+15.98%，營收102.7億美元，資料中心強勁帶動獲利。
ai_view_zh: 訊號強勁正向：EPS大幅超預期16%，資料中心動能延續，AI晶片放量驗證執行力。短中期股價受惠於AI需求結構性成長與市占擴張。追蹤指標：資料中心與AI GPU營收年增、毛利率、AI加速器訂單能見度、客戶端復甦。雖然基本面強勁，但182倍本益比代表市場已高度定價，後續須以實質出貨與毛利持續驗證，方能維持估值。
ai_view_en: Signal strongly positive: EPS beat by 16% with sustained data-center momentum and AI-chip ramp validating execution. Near to mid-term, the stock benefits from structural AI demand and share gains. Track: data-center and AI GPU revenue growth, gross margin, accelerator order visibility, and client recovery. Despite strong fundamentals, a 182x P/E means the market has priced in a lot; sustained shipments and margins are needed to hold the valuation.
highlights_zh: EPS 1.53美元，大幅超出預期1.32美元，驚喜幅度15.98%。
單季營收102.7億美元，反映AI與伺服器需求旺盛。
EPYC伺服器CPU市占持續提升，貢獻穩定成長。
Instinct GPU受惠AI訓練與推論需求擴張。
產品組合升級推動毛利率改善。
highlights_en: EPS of $1.53 beat the $1.32 estimate by 15.98%.
Quarterly revenue of $10.27B reflects robust AI and server demand.
EPYC server CPU share keeps rising, driving steady growth.
Instinct GPUs benefit from expanding AI training and inference demand.
risks_zh: 極高本益比對任何成長或毛利不及預期敏感。
AI GPU面臨市場主導者的激烈競爭。
客戶端與遊戲業務需求仍具週期性。
risks_en: A very high P/E is sensitive to any growth or margin shortfall.
AI GPUs face fierce competition from the market leader.
Client and gaming demand remains cyclical.
